title: Cetus Central
summary: Enterprise IoT platform for industrial energy, with real-time ingestion across distributed devices and sub-millisecond state reads.
problem: Industrial energy operators need to see grid state in real time, but the data arrives from distributed devices speaking half a dozen incompatible protocols, at a frequency that breaks ordinary request-response architectures.
approach: A microservices architecture for real-time ingestion, with Kafka carrying the stream, Redis holding live state and PostgreSQL as the system of record. Reads of current grid state never wait on the write path.
highlights: Designed the microservices architecture for real-time ingestion across distributed systems.
Built Kafka, Redis and PostgreSQL pipelines tuned for sub-millisecond state reads.
Implemented event-driven APIs and streaming systems for high-frequency sensor data.
Integrated MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus and IEC 61850 for grid compliance.
Built and coordinated six core modules: power quality, fault outage, energy integrity, topology twin, communication data and metering.
Secured with JWT, RBAC and TLS to regulatory standards.
Built the database schemas and migration scripts.
Zero-downtime deployment through Docker and Azure; test suites at roughly 90% coverage.
